latest.title: Feedback device lifts paediatric ventilation quality
latest.finding: Guideline-recommended tidal volume in 87% of breaths with feedback vs 16.2% without; rate adherence 88.6% vs 65%; mask leak <30% in 88.4% vs 80%

latest.title: TBI in first responders needs occupational pathways
latest.finding: Substantial TBI burden in law enforcement, fire and EMS with persistent gaps in diagnosis, rehabilitation and duty-readiness; 28 recommendations spanning recognition, early assessment, return to duty and organisational policy

latest.title: Joint training lifts behavioural emergency confidence
latest.finding: Self-efficacy rose from 3.16 to 3.54 (mean difference 0.39, 95% CI 0.34–0.44, dz 0.76) and cognition from 3.81 to 3.95; behavioural-emergency stigma rose slightly and substance-use stigma was unchanged
